Coram : R. BANUMATHI*, S. ABDUL NAZEER, A.S. BOPANNA
U.P. Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms Act, 1950 – ss.157-B, 161, 166, 167 – Respondents entered into an exchange with a member of Scheduled Tribe by way of registered exchange deed – Respondents gave 4½ Muthi of land in return for 12 Nali of agricultural land held that the exchange violates s.161(1) and the exchange deed being in violation of provisions of the 1950 Act is void – Respondents filed appeal – Dismissed – Revision petition – Dismissed – Writ petition filed by the respondents – Allowed – Held:
Decision Date : 03-03-2020 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 7346/2010 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 3 Judges
